reason: My last software died because the staff never used it, and here the second ₹5,000 only gets paid if my stylists are actually billing, and the data is backed up and downloadable, so my real worries are covered. ₹500 a month is nothing next to what one lost stylist or one leaky cash drawer costs me across two outlets, so I'd try it at my main salon first.
objection: It is one person supporting everything. If he gets busy with other salons or shuts down, I am stuck again with an app my staff just learned, and I don't want my customer list sitting with someone who could also sell to the salon that took my stylists.
